chapter.heading: A Song of degrees of David.
chapter.v:
LORD, my
heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

Surely I
have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

Let Israel
hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
